name: EditorialTextButton

props.description: Render the child link as the action.
props.name: asChild

related: EditorialTextLink — the bold arrow link of a section head.
tagline: An underlined text action in the primary tone (gh#1439): "Reset display preferences", "Your collection →". A `<button>` by default; `asChild` turns a router link into it; `icon` trails the label. Geometry: `--editorial-text-button-*`.
usage: DO use it for a quiet secondary action next to copy; a primary action is a Button.
